A share that holds steady while the city moves means the community is following the city; a share that drifts means it is moving differently.

items.t: New Horizons condos and townhomes for sale

blocks.text: New Horizons home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

59 condos sold in New Horizons with a median price of $695,000 (the middle half sold between $640,000 and $776,400), taking a median of 20 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $761 per square foot, a median year built of 2016 and a median strata fee of $441 a month. 23 houses sold in New Horizons with a median price of $1,200,000 (the middle half sold between $1,111,500 and $1,256,444), taking a median of 12 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $601 per square foot, a median year built of 1980 and a median lot of 4,101 square feet.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in New Horizons?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 6 houses and 29 condos and townhomes listed in New Horizons. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is New Horizons a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes had 14% (a balanced market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in New Horizons from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 6 houses and 27 condos and townhomes sold in New Horizons over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in July with 3 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in June with 11 sold.

faq.q: How big is New Horizons compared with the rest of Coquitlam?
faq.a: In September 2026, New Horizons held 1.4% of the 425 detached houses listed in Coquitlam and 3.6% of the 806 condos and townhomes listed in Coquitlam.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in New Horizons?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 17.1% of the 35 homes listed in New Horizons and condos and townhomes made up 82.9%; of the 4 that sold, houses were 0.0% and condos and townhomes 100.0%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in New Horizons than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses rose from 5 in June to 6 in September 2026 (+20.0%); condos and townhomes fell from 33 in June to 29 in September 2026 (−12.1%).

faq.q: What did condos in New Horizons sell for?
faq.a: 59 condos sold in New Horizons between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $695,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in New Horizons?
faq.a: The median was 20 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.4% of the last list price (3% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
